title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In October 2024, French Roofing replaced the worn shingle roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore the old shingles off down to the deck and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles over synthetic underlayment, with new valley metal, flashings, roof vents and hip and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck and re-nailed loose decking
Installed synthetic underlayment, drip edge, gutter apron and starter strip
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with metal valleys
New step flashing, counter flashing at the masonry and new pipe flashings
New ridge vents and roof vents, finished with hip and ridge cap shingles
body: Before the work, the old shingles had gone faded and streaky across the roof. The first two photos below are taken from about the same spot by the chimney, before and after.

faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark shingles, over synthetic underlayment, with metal valleys, new flashings, new roof vents and hip and ridge cap.
